title: The shorted lamp
prompt: A lamp and a 10 ohm resistor are in series on 6 V. The lamp is shorted.
explanation: Removing resistance from a loop makes the current rise, not fall: I = 6 / 10 = 0.6 A.

lines: A short is a path with almost zero resistance
Voltage across it: V = I x 0
So a meter across the lamp reads about 0 V
The loop current falls, because a part stopped working
